checks.name: Default game: without ?pavement none of the pavement modules or textures is fetched
Default game: no pavement material, attribute or layout exists (the world is baked as before)
Default game: no page errors
?pavement: the six pavement textures load without error
?pavement: textures are 1024 x 1024, tiled, trilinear mipmapped, anisotropic, linear data
?pavement: real-world scale (asphalt 2.5 m per tile = 410 px/m; concrete 2.0 m = 512 px/m; the Art Bible asks 256-512 px/m)
?pavement: no request leaves the local server
?pavement: every pavement batch carries finite street coordinates (uv) and a unit along-direction (pv)
?pavement: on Oak Hollow Drive the asphalt's coordinates are the street's own (u within 5 cm of d, v within 5 cm of the lateral offset)
?pavement: no UV stretch at bends: micro-structure in world metres; street-coordinate features within 6 % of true length at the asphalt edge on the tightest bend

Geometry: every merged surface, shadow proxy and line has exactly the default game's vertices (positions hashed at 1 mm), but for the soil faces added beside driveway aprons and the cul-de-sac bulb, tessellated to follow the ground
Gameplay: surface heights, rideability, standing ground and authored pads at 30848 street points are identical; obstacles, navigation shapes and driveway openings unchanged
Riding: a scripted ride over a driveway cut onto the walk, and one into a plain curb, follow exactly the same path, speed and wheel height

Junctions and cul-de-sac: rays from above find a surface everywhere, never below the street's ground, and every surface within 3.5 cm of the authored height away from curbs and surface edges (no gaps, no floating or sunken surfaces; the default game's bulb sank up to 4 cm: reported as without)
?pavement (measures): no page errors
Comparison: O swaps RECONSTRUCTED (shader on, old decal patches / joint bars / crack lines hidden) and ORIGINAL (shader off, all shown) in the same frame
Captures: every before/after pair is one camera and one frame
Cost: in every pair the reconstruction draws no more draw calls than the original and at most 1 % more triangles (the soil faces)
?pavement: no page errors (every pavement shader compiles and links)
Prologue only: active in the Prologue; in Chapter One the original surfaces show (the reconstruction is inactive)
Chapter One with ?pavement: no page errors
Aftermath I: the reconstruction is inactive, and Chapter Eight's ground cuts are installed on every pavement material
Aftermath I with ?pavement: no page errors
All four benchmarks together (?bikes&houses&vegetation&pavement) load without error; the lawn is the repair (C)
Lawn: the repaired lawn's masks build the same lawn cells in the same chunks as without ?pavement (grass boundaries unchanged)
Four benchmarks: no page errors; riding works with them all on
Offline package (PLAYTEST_MODELS=1): the six pavement textures and the pavement modules are embedded
Offline package from disk, browser offline: ?pavement loads its textures from the embedded bytes, with no network request
Offline package: no page errors
Default package (no models): ?pavement fails loudly and substitutes nothing (the original surfaces stay)
